notes.title: Axial Ramification Update!
notes.notes:
Dear friends of a chemical conundrum!

Another update of Molecule has been released.

Here the list of changes:
- fixed a glitch with axial-symmetric atoms causing some solutions not being considered correctly
- fixed wrong ordering in level selection
- enabled v-sync to increase compatibility
- small cosmetic tweaks

Happy puzzling!

-j
